svg.aria-label: Left: as the fraud base rate rises from 5 to 12 percent over a year, AUC on matured cohorts stays flat near 0.9 while expected calibration error climbs past an alert line. Right: reliability curves for month 1 sit on the diagonal and for month 12 sit above it, meaning the model is under-confident
